answer: Each epoch the protocol pairs accounts at random and makes each one cross-examine its partner's answer with three follow-up questions that only the real author could resolve. The kernel of the check is a mirror test: the author must reproduce reasoning that matches their submission, with an opal-clear trace. A farm running 50 aliases must pay a competent human or model for 150 live replies every epoch, so cost scales linearly per fake head, and failures forfeit a bond.
